data.name: Eramya
data.long_meaning: Eramya is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Era’ meaning love and ‘Mya’ meaning mother or goddess. This name symbolizes the divine love and nurturing care of a mother. In Hindu mythology, Eramya is an incarnation of the goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity. She is also known as the goddess of love, compassion, and fertility.
